assertions.assertion: The denial carries reason code CO-50.
CPT 93229 corresponds to mobile cardiac telemetry.
The clinical indication note documents the patient's presentation.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness.
Dizziness and giddiness is coded R42.
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries.
Atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries is coded I25.10.
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded I34.0.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes.
The payer determined the service was not medically necessary.
